pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: src/features/studio/studioHistory.ts:134 Studio's only durable knobs (goalsOpen, sheetStyle, gatePlanDefault, open tabs) live in a zustand persist localStorage slice, and its per-turn build controls are in-memory runtime fields (src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:318 effort defaults inline, passed per call at :583); the context reads and writes no app_settings key, so the backend key-space techniques have no surface here and the golden path's Boundaries section assigns client-persisted view state to client-state

techniques.evidence: src/features/studio/studioHistory.ts:134 the persisted slice is keyed by one client-state store name, not by setting keys; no app-settings key is referenced anywhere under src/features/studio
src/features/studio/StudioBuildSettings.tsx:45 values are read typed from the in-memory runtime (BuildStyle union, inline default), not parsed from a stored string
src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:768 setBuildSettings patches runtime and a localStorage preference; nothing reaches a settings store that could be audited
src/features/studio/studioHistory.ts:130 the persisted members are user/view preferences (goals rail, sheet style), none an operational config, ceiling or flag

pairs.registryProposal: Borderline worth naming in the client-state/settings boundary: gatePlanDefault (src/features/studio/studioHistory.ts:68-72) is a localStorage preference that changes agent behavior (whether a build pauses for plan review) and is lost on a WebView clear; the boundary rule 'drives backend behavior => setting' does not say how to classify a client-orchestrated behavioral gate.
